$comment: Cover letter output schema. In the current pipeline the cover letter is one field within the Phase 2 writer JSON response (alongside resume, evidence_ledger, domain_translation_ledger). This schema documents the cover_letter field only.
description: Cover letter portion of the Phase 2 writer output.

cover_letter.description: Plain-text cover letter. 3–4 paragraphs, 200–350 words. Must include company name and role. If domain_mismatch=true, must include verbatim bridge sentence from the plan.

full_phase2_output.$comment: Full Phase 2 writer response shape for reference.

resume.description: Plain-text tailored resume preserving all original role headers and dates.

cover_letter.description: Plain-text cover letter as described above.

evidence_ledger.description: Keyed by required item; each value contains exact_span and location for verifiability.

domain_translation_ledger.description: One entry per applied domain translation rule with rule_id, target_frame_used, exact_span, and location.
